summary: Fan controller firmware using a DHT22 temperature sensor and an output pin for the fan, featuring threshold control, overheat alarms, and serial telemetry.
error_handling: Spec requires sensor fail detection and fail-safe, but it is not implemented in the source code.

spec_rules.text: Fan is ON when temperature >= 30.0 C.
Once ON, the fan turns OFF only when temperature <= 28.0 C (2 C hysteresis).
Fan is OFF at boot and stays OFF while temperature is below 30.0 C.
Temperature >= 60.0 C prints "[ALARM] OVERHEAT" and the fan is ON.
If the sensor read fails, print "[ERROR] SENSOR_FAIL" and turn the fan ON (fail-safe).
When the sensor recovers, print "[INFO] SENSOR_OK" and resume normal control.

risk_areas: Hysteresis requirement (R2) is missing from the code; instead of 28.0 C hysteresis, line 44 uses t > 30.0 and line 46 uses t < 30.0.
Sensor failure error handling (R5 and R6) is completely unimplemented; dht.readTemperature() returning NaN is not checked.
Potential floating-point comparison issue at exact threshold boundaries.
